"A cost-effective pasta restaurant in Hongdae filled with delicious smells right from the entrance."

Taste: Toowoomba pasta has a rich sauce and goes perfectly with the noodles. The meat pasta with juicy homemade meatballs also exceeded expectations. Since you can adjust the spiciness (level 0.5 recommended), I enjoyed it until the end.

Side: I was satisfied with the pepperoni pizza I ordered as it was rich in cheese, and the cream churros I received as part of a review event were perfect for dessert.

Atmosphere: It's a good restaurant, so there's a bit of a wait, but the turnover rate is fast, and although there are mainly seats for two, the response is flexible, with tables being adjusted according to the number of people.

reviews.author: actor mom
reviews.text:
While stopping by Sinchon, I went to Pastago Hongdae, a cost-effective restaurant near Hongdae! I went to the Magok branch last week, and my first son raved about how delicious the risotto was, so I went again. The store is small, but the tree and Christmas decorations have a great atmosphere✨ There is also a self-service bar, so it was comfortable.

There is a discount event going on right now, so most of the menu items are priced in the low 10,000 won range! We ate a generous portion of Cheese Shower Tomato Risotto, Garlic Butter Cream Risotto, Cream Churros, and French Fries for less than 30,000 won, so it was recognized as a cost-effective Hongdae restaurant🙌

A place where I was satisfied with the taste, price, and friendliness!

reviews.author: Solsol

Overall, I was satisfied with the quality of the food, the price, and the atmosphere.

The staff were friendly and the food came out quickly, so I was able to enjoy it even during lunch time.
More than anything, I was really surprised that I could enjoy this level of quality at this price.
Isn’t this a truly authentic Hongdae restaurant?

reviews.text: Gnocquiteria Smoke is a restaurant near Exit 3 of Hongik University Station. In addition to gnocchi, there are a variety of foods including pasta, steak, salad, and grilled eggplant. The texture of the soft and chewy gnocchi was good, and the cream sauce had a good truffle flavor. Unlike the pasta I had previously eaten, the aglio olio had finely chopped garlic, so I could smell it well, and the grilled eggplant was also a delicacy. All the menu items are so delicious that I want to come back and try all the other menu items. It has a Christmas atmosphere so I will definitely come back at the end of the year. All the staff were friendly too.

reviews.author: silverline
reviews.text: I visited this place while looking for a pasta restaurant in Yeonnam-dong, and the menu combination was really fresh. Even though it was a cream pasta, it was not greasy and had a good balance, and the texture of the gnocchi was also satisfactory. The space was comfortable and the staff were friendly, so I had a pleasant meal. This is a place I want to come back to when I want to eat pasta near Yeontral Park.

reviews.author: Inpyo Baek
reviews.text: The atmosphere of the store is very nice, so it would be great for dates, gatherings, and blind dates! The food is all delicious, from the main menu to the side dishes👍 This is a great pasta restaurant in Yeonnam-dong!

reviews.author: sunhwa Lee
reviews.text:
It was located in an alley in Yeonnam-dong, so it was quiet and the atmosphere was really nice.
Both the pasta and gnocchi had solid flavors, so even though it was a fusion menu, I enjoyed it without any pressure.
In particular, the red pepper paste cream gnocchi was impressive with its chewy texture, savory flavor, and slightly spicy flavor.
The price is in the mid-10,000 won range, so it's very cost-effective for Yeonnam-dong, and it's a place I'd like to visit again for a date or casual gathering.

reviews.author: mom iizi
reviews.text: I had the red crab bisque risotto and it really impressed me. The scent of red crab is strong but not fishy, ​​and the bisque sauce is savory and soft, so I kept eating spoon after spoonful. The rice grains were not too spread out and were still alive enough, so the texture was good and the overall flavor was deep. If you like seafood risotto, this is a menu that will satisfy you.

reviews.author: tndus
reviews.text:
The most delicious pasta restaurant in Yeonnam-dong!
I enjoyed it so much last time that I came back this time, and all the menu items I ordered this time were also very delicious.

Red crab bisque risotto, Cajun ragu pasta, bacon olive potato, and chili peanut menbocha are all so delicious!

You must try the bacon olive pocheito⭐️

Awesome.. it was the most satisfying of all the places I’ve been to recently.

reviews.text: It's a bit far from Hongdae's main street, but I wonder if there's a place in Hongdae where you can get the atmosphere, taste, and pretty menu for this price. Pasta around 8-9000 won, pizza around 12000 won (larger sizes are more expensive)

reviews.author: Peter Greed
reviews.text: I was able to eat great pasta and pizza at a reasonable price for the location. The chili cream pasta, which has thin dough and light toppings, is moderately spicy and has a soft cream that goes well together. I was able to eat comfortably

reviews.author: GD KIM
reviews.text:
It's hard to evaluate since I've only tried the mushroom cream, but if I were to look at just one, it felt like it surpassed the cream pasta and noodles. The cream pasta sauce itself was delicious, but there were too many onions in it, so it ended up being too watery. The good thing is that the inside of the store was quiet and the food came out quickly.
I won't know for sure until I try other menu items. However, it is fun to have a store like this in a neighborhood alley.

reviews.author: Seoulite

Risotto with black rice is so soft
They are even kind enough to adjust the spiciness to your liking!!
A place I want to go again~~

reviews.author: YS LEE
reviews.text:
A collaboration between delicious pizza and craft beer!
The pizza is salty, savory, and delicious, and I think it's great to be able to enjoy various award-winning beers together. It has a nice atmosphere and is like an American pub, so it's a place full of charm that you often go to when you go to Hongdae.

reviews.author: happy every day
reviews.text:
I was really surprised when I saw the size of the pizza! I ordered three pieces, but it feels like I get more than one piece, so it's great value for money. It is clearly visible that the owner does not skimp on ingredients.
​The dumpling curry pizza is very creative because it is topped with plenty of round dumplings.
Thanks to the curry seasoning, the spicy and umami flavor exploded, making it my favorite dish!
American Bulbuck Pizza is very delicious with the combination of bulgogi topping and barbecue sauce. If you eat the sweet Verible Soboro Pizza to finish, it's perfect as a dessert.
​Belgian Wheat Ale is fragrant and drinkable. I'm planning to go again soon to try out the menu one by one! Totally recommend

reviews.author: Chaehyun Kim
reviews.text:
I visited for the first time today, and it was so delicious that I was very satisfied overall.🥰
The spicy fusilli pizza goes well with the spicy sauce and the fusilli, so it's not greasy and has a taste that you can't stop using, while the brown potato pizza is light yet has a potato texture, so I think it's good to eat regardless of whether you like it or not👍🤍
The slice of border pizza at other places is huge and generous, and the nachos and French fries are crispy and not soggy, so it's perfect to eat with pizza! I recommend ordering pizza and sides🤍🤍❤️
Next time, I want to order other menu items.

reviews.author: Baek Ji-young
reviews.text:
I went to Raymond, a small New York found at the entrance of Hongik University! From the vintage blue and red tone of the exterior to the Manhattan feel, it was really pretty to take pictures. We had the Lay set, and the freshness of the pizza dough was exceptional, perhaps because it was limited to 30 pieces per weekend. I thoroughly enjoyed the 20-inch giant pizza slice, juicy sausage, and truffle fries. As expected from a Hongdae restaurant, the pizza was authentic American style from appearance to taste. I was also curious about the world champion craft beer, Art Monster, and its combination with the refreshing Zero Cola was also the best. Next time, I definitely want to come back for Pimac!
#Hongdae Restaurant Pizza #Raymond #Hongdae Pimac #Hongik University Entrance Restaurant #American Pizza

reviews.author: Yoohyeonah
reviews.text:
It's a great place to have a quick drink in Hongdae 🍕🍺
You can order pizza by the slice, so it was great to share different flavors.

I ordered a mac and cheese pizza, a slice of pepperoni pizza, and Coca-Cola Zero.
The mac and cheese is thick and has a strong cheese flavor, so I recommend it to those who like cheese! The pepperoni was salty and slightly spicy, so it had a basic taste that went well with beer.

The atmosphere is casual, so it's great for a casual visit with friends.

I think I'll visit again when I feel like a slice of pizza in Hongdae 😊

reviews.author: Saerom Kim
reviews.text:
Because it was Valentine's Day, it was difficult to get a table without a reservation, but they told us to sit down if we finished eating within an hour, so we did.
Let's take a seat. Bordeaux, a river rat, was lying down next to our table. It was so big and plump that it filled the space between our table and the table next to us. This is a tea dog that shows the attitude that if you don't want to give it something delicious, don't bother.
I ordered truffle cream pasta, vongole oil pasta, and a bottle of white wine.
I think I know what it means to say that noodles are alive. The clams had a clear sense of texture and were large and plump. The amount of truffle on top of the pasta was small, but the scent was no joke.
We ate quickly and got up for the young Valentine's couples.
Bordeaux got up and went toward the kitchen as if he had been waiting for us to wake up. Dinner was even more enjoyable thanks to Bordeaux. Thank you Bordeaux!
It's so delicious that I definitely want to stop by again before I return to the US.

reviews.author: Heeyeon Lee
reviews.text: The food is delicious! I ordered Toowoomba pasta, aglio olio, and gnocchi, and it was delicious!!🤤🤤 Free corkage is also provided, so it's great to drink the alcohol you brought with you:) The atmosphere is nice, and I want to come again next time. It's the best👍👍👍

reviews.author: Seongwoo park
reviews.text:
Yeonnam-dong Blanc Noir. With wine and cheese platter. The atmosphere is so good. Free wine corkage.
Tiramisu is beautiful. Is it so delicious? I soaked it in some coffee and the flavor came out even better. Other places use cheap creams to save on raw materials. Blanc Noir seemed to use mascarpone cream. No parking.

The steak was really, really delicious!!!

The bread was very warm and the pasta was very good.

The store has a nice atmosphere and is quiet, so it's great for a date.

I highly recommend you visit if you come to Yeonnam-dong.

reviews.author: Joo-seong Son
reviews.text:
The tomato pasta is absolutely delicious. I didn't expect it to taste this good at this price, but it's good value for money and I recommend it.
The steak is soft and not tough.

reviews.author: Byungkyu SHIN
reviews.text: The price is not as cheap as you think. The pizza size is quite small. It is difficult to find because the location is ambiguous. The sunlight shines too much near the window, making it uncomfortable to sit for a long time. There are not too many magnets. The beer tastes okay, but it's bittersweet. Hot wings are not for Korean tastes, but it seems to vary depending on preference. Personally, I recommend it.

reviews.author: Soyon Michelle
reviews.text:
I visited at 8:30 on a Thursday evening.
Fortunately, there was someone who got up as soon as we arrived, so we sat down right away!

It's a bit of a small space, but there are about 3-4 tables and a bar.

The menu consists of pizza, beer, and side dishes.

The portion seemed a little small compared to the price of the pizza.
Do you think one adult can eat one plate?

First of all, I ordered pepperoni mushrooms and draft beer, but it came out very late. I tried one slice first and tried to order more, but when I saw the speed of the pizza coming out and the size of the pizza, I tried to order right away... but the staff didn't make eye contact with us and said they would go take our order because they were busy, but they didn't come... I started to feel bad.

Even though they brought us beer, it was late... There were foreigners at the table next to us, and they happily took our orders right away hahaha ^^

I ordered the second plate with cheese.
It's called American taste, but I'm not sure.
The service made me frown, perhaps because I had already thought about it.
It was a place I felt embarrassed taking my friends to.

reviews.author: Somin Kim
reviews.text:
I ordered half pepperoni and half white musium pizza at Tom's Pizza in Hongdae! The pepperoni was salty and spicy, which was totally my style, and the white musum was very good because the cream sauce was soft and rich in mushrooms. I think I was able to eat it more lightly because the dough was thin and crispy. It was the perfect pizza for pizza!

I went to Tom’s Pizza in Hongdae and ordered half pepperoni, half white mushroom. The pepperoni was savory and spicy—totally my style! The white mushroom had a rich, creamy sauce and plenty of mushrooms, which was amazing. The crust was thin and crispy, so it didn’t feel heavy at all. It’s perfect for a casual pizza and beer night!

reviews.author: ¡Qué Rico! (Sseulikko)
reviews.text:
It is famous as the place that serves the best ‘American hot wings’ in Korea. The name is a pizza restaurant, but it is more famous for its chicken wings. This may be a bit of an unfamiliar taste to Koreans. If you are an international student, you will know this taste. The important point is that it is Frank's hot sauce base, not Tabasco. The homemade blue cheese dipping is also amazing. If you are an international student, you must visit. It will be a trip down memory lane.

Named as 'Korea's Best Hot Wings'. Tom uses Franks Hot Sauce and his secret ingredient which makes his wings so special. Blue Cheese dipping was amazing as well. Definitely worth visiting

reviews.author: Jin Seung-eon
reviews.text: I visited after seeing it on YouTube. As I sat at the bar, Uncle Tom started talking to me a lot. I ordered triple meat, half lamb and waffle fries. The waffle fries were waffle-shaped fries, and they were much more delicious than I expected. It's an open kitchen, so you can see how the pizza is made, and the baking skills are extraordinary. First of all, the pizza was very salty and it was truly American style pizza. I was a little disappointed that there wasn't a lot of cheese on top, but I liked the overall combination. In particular, the lamb pizza was served with cilantro, which was a very new combination as it was not found in pizza. Of course it tastes good too. Uncle Tom said all the other pizzas were delicious, so I want to try other things next time.

reviews.author: Stephen Chow
reviews.text: If you're looking for a French restaurant with a nice atmosphere in Hongdae, I really recommend La Run Violette💜 The purple accent interior is elegant, and it's quiet for lunch, so it's perfect for a date. The lunch course is perfect, from amuse bouche to dessert, and in particular, the Ganimiso pasta has a rich and savory cream sauce, so you must try it. Each dish, including scallop bridge, beef tartare, and lamb fangs, is full of flavor and is highly satisfying. A Hongdae pasta restaurant with perfect visuals, taste, and atmosphere. I 100% plan to visit again✨

reviews.author: Agnese
reviews.text:
I met a friend for the first time in a while and had a weekday dinner course, and I was pleasantly full. It was really nice that the courses were adjusted appropriately to our eating pace rather than being rushed out.

Particularly delicious menu items:
1. Ratatouille - The vegetable stew has a deep flavor but is not greasy at all, and the combination of poached eggs and popovers is fantastic.
2. Ganimiso Pasta - The crab intestine sauce is thick and rich, and the noodles are al dente, perfect.
3. Gwanja Bridge - The combination of bisque soup and fresh scallops is impressive.

The dinner course costs 48,000 won per person and includes an amuse bouche, seasonal salad, two main dishes, and dessert. I don't dine often, so I'm not sure if it's really good value for money, but the food quality was definitely good.

The atmosphere is nice and the tables are spaced apart, so it's perfect for eating while chatting comfortably.

Recommended for when you want to enjoy a French course without the burden in Hongdae, for friend gatherings, or for anniversaries.

reviews.author: Minky
reviews.text:
This is a place in Hongdae where you can enjoy a proper French course at a reasonable price.
I ordered the lunch course, and everything from amuse bouche to dessert was plentiful and the plating was really pretty.
In particular, the flavor of the truffle canard and the rich snow crab intestine sauce of the gani miso pasta were impressive, and the combination of dipping scallops in bisque sauce and eating them with a baguette was an explosion of umami ❤️
The final dessert, Panna Cotta, was finished neatly with the freshness of strawberries, and the space is spacious and has a nice atmosphere, so I highly recommend it for a date or anniversary meal.
Being able to eat high-quality food at this price is a huge leap in value for money, so I often want to come here on anniversaries 😋

reviews.author: Boya
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a French restaurant with a nice atmosphere in Hongdae, I definitely recommend this place💜
The purple accents from the exterior were very pretty, and the interior was really luxurious, from the chandelier to the table settings.
For the lunch course, I ordered ratatouille & popover, beef tartare, truffle canard, and gani miso pasta.
Everything was neat and delicious.
In particular, the beef tartare was so fresh and tender that I definitely wanted to eat it again.
The staff was friendly and the atmosphere was quiet, so it was perfect for a date or anniversary meal!

reviews.author: CcoCaa MowMow
reviews.text: Larun Violette Hongdae Main Branch is a restaurant where you can enjoy a full course meal at a reasonable price. It's close to Hongik University Station, so it's easily accessible, and the store is spacious and the tables are spaced apart, so it's comfortable to chat. Starting with the amuse bouche, followed by fresh tomato salad, ratatouille popover, scallop bridge, beef steak, and the signature gani miso pasta, the course composition was rich and there was no time to get bored. In particular, the Kani miso pasta was really impressive as the savory flavor of the crab intestines and the thick cream were perfectly combined. At the end, dessert and coffee were neatly served, making me feel like I was in a hotel lounge. This is a space I would recommend as a date spot in Hongdae or a meal on a special day.

reviews.author: K EN

The owner and his wife are friendly and the food is delicious.
I think it would be great if all the exterior windows were opened later.

reviews.author: Stella Lee
reviews.text:
I stopped by this place without a reservation a few years ago and left because there were no seats, but I made a reservation for this year's year-end party and was like, "Oh, it's here." I arrived 20 minutes earlier than the opening time, and the weather got so cold that I thought I'd do something if I couldn't wait indoors, but fortunately it was open.
They gave it to us. The food was so delicious and it was nice that they recommended wine according to the food we wanted to order. We were a group of 5 people and everything we ordered was delicious so we went crazy. They took great care to create a Christmas atmosphere at each table and it was a bit cold inside.
I want to visit again and try the food~~

The owner was very friendly and I was satisfied!!

reviews.author: jangwon choi
reviews.text:
Boudcomde and Hongdae where we had a year-end gathering with high school friends.
Although I had a trip to Vietnam scheduled for the next day, I still attended the meeting.
I went to Budcomde and Hongdae because I believed it was a regular restaurant of a friend who is a university professor.
It's quite far from Hongik University Station, so you have to walk for about 10 minutes from Exit 2 to get there.

Boubou de Comde opens at 12 o'clock every day and closes at 11 o'clock.
Open until 11:30 on Saturdays and 1:00 pm on Sundays.
It opens at 5:30 p.m. on Mondays only and is open until 11 p.m.
Break time is usually from 3pm to 5:30pm, but not on Saturdays and Sundays.

They say parking is possible, but it's not a separate parking lot.
You must check in advance before visiting and leave immediately after eating.
When I visited in December, the parking lot was spacious so all my friends could park there.
Although the location was vague, it was worth walking to.

I went at the appointed time and there were already a lot of customers at Boubou de Comde and Hongdae.
It was a pre-Christmas atmosphere and a tree welcomed us.
Tableware and glasses were already neatly prepared on the large table in the center.
The food was served according to the ingredients that came in that day.

Jamon salad, a combination of fresh salad delivered the same day from the farm and plenty of jamon,
17,000 won
Cream fondant monkfish, a food made by wrapping monkfish meat in bacon and baking it in a pan, slowly cooking it in cream,
25,000 won
Bubu Chicken, a signature menu with a fantastic combination of oven-baked chicken and raclette cheese,
27,000 won
Seasonal seafood papillote, a dish made with sea bass and three types of shellfish (ramie, clam, and clam),
27,000 won
Ragu pasta, beef cooked for 5 hours, pasta noodles, topped with cheese and served with a toasted baguette, 25,000 won

9 friends had a great time eating and drinking together.
Me and one other friend had an event the next day, so we came out in a hurry.
Rumor has it that other friends had a second meal at a nearby sundae soup restaurant.
A great restaurant in Hongik University Station that is great to eat with friends
Bou de comm de wa.

The lasagna was good, and the chicken was also good. One dish comes packaged.

reviews.author: CampingshowCamping show

The price is usually considered value for money.

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
After eating the mediocre ebiyaki curry at Bistro Kyushu, I felt less full and it felt awkward to go home without stopping by a good restaurant, so I opened Naver Maps and saw Old Rookie's Burger among the recommended stores. When I looked at Manple, there weren't many reviews, but I saw a review by Sukjeolmi, who seemed familiar to me, so I walked to the store since it was nearby.

Looking at it here and there, the prices felt quite reasonable and I wondered if this might be a lesser-known handmade burger shop that I might like. After hesitating for a moment, I decided to sacrifice myself and went up to the second floor of the building where the shop was located.

There is a skateboard decorated in the middle of the stairs leading up to the second floor where the store is located, showing that the owner chef is a skateboarder, and as you enter the store, you can see many decorations related to skateboards.

There was only one couple customers, and the owner chef showed up from the kitchen and informed us that we could order through the kiosk.

The menu is simple and consists of only three types of burgers, and I ordered the most basic burger, the Rookie Burger, as a set that included French fries and a drink.

The owner chef informed me that I could choose a beverage from the refrigerated showcase, excluding beer but including carbonated water, and that if I needed ice, I could use the cup and ice dispenser provided on one side of the store.

Fortunately, among the drinks, I saw my favorite Dr. Pepper, so I took out the Dr. Pepper, put ice in a paper cup, and took a straw and a napkin.

The business card of the store had a picture of the owner chef on it, and I thought it was funny because it reminded me of Beavis and Butt-Head, an MTV cartoon I loved when I was young.

As I was drinking Dr. Pepper, he told me that the rookie burger I ordered was ready, so I went to the kitchen to pick it up. When I asked if there was mayonnaise to dip the French fries in, he said he would bring it to my seat, so I returned to my seat.

I was a bit worried because there weren't many reviews, but the burgers looked good, raising expectations as to whether this might be a good burger place.

They soon brought me some mayonnaise, but French fries were made with potatoes anyway, so I thought there was nothing special about them, so I decided to try the burger first.

When I looked at it, it was a smash burger type that was baked by pressing the patty in a pan. It felt real, not messy, and it was just the right size to hold in my hand and eat, so I took a bite and the edges of the patty were slightly burnt and crunchy. It seemed like they made the patty with good quality meat, and there was no unpleasant smell. It was juicy and the cheese and bacon were reasonably salty, so it was not a fake burger place.

I think they made their own sauce, but the lemon in the sauce had a nice tartness to it, and overall it was good. It was no worse than the expensive, flashy stores where you have to wait in line, and the atmosphere of the store was simple, so it was more my type, and I liked it, which made me smile.

I enjoyed eating a burger and French fries dipped in mayonnaise. It tasted like a common product, potatoes, so it wasn't bad, but it wasn't special either.

Since it was self-service, I cleaned up everything I ate, said good-bye, and went out.

Overall, I was feeling a little down because the ebiyaki curry I tried with high expectations didn't live up to my expectations, but the burger I tried at Old Rookie's Burger recommended by Naver Map was cheap, but the quality and taste were not inferior to those of popular and expensive restaurants, and it wasn't crowded, so I was satisfied with my visit. It was a pleasant visit that I thought I would stop by again when I want a handmade burger when I come to this neighborhood.

This is my 3rd building, but there were no seats every time I went.

reviews.author: BONG
reviews.text:
Very quiet compared to other Shake Shack stores
There are only a few foreigners and there are almost no Koreans. Maybe it's because there are many alternative restaurants in the neighborhood, but it's nice and comfortable.
The store itself is spacious and has two rows, so the movement lines are clean.

The kiosk where you order can be a bit crowded and the line can be long, but the staff will take care of it right away.

I like the set menu because it is quite affordable.

reviews.author: Hyangmi Kim
reviews.text: I remember when Shake Shack first arrived in Gangnam, Korea. I had the highest level of satisfaction while waiting in line to eat, but now Shake Shack has become just an expensive regular burger! I don't know if my taste buds have changed or Shake Shack has changed, but it doesn't taste the same as before.

reviews.author: A little strange daily life
reviews.text:

I stopped by to eat~

Because I gained weight, I tend to hold back a bit.

I have to be satisfied~

Sprinkling pepper and salt on potatoes
I like it very much
Now that summer is here... Shake + Fries
I need to open a union~

reviews.author: Go Hee-seok
reviews.text: It's been a while since I came to Hongdae and I was looking around and stumbled upon this place, and it was a place that was serious about chicken sandwiches. Plastic gloves, forks, and knives were all provided, so it was very easy to eat and the taste was really delicious. Since cooking starts only after you place your order, I really liked the piping hot chicken patties that were freshly served. I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: lily
reviews.text:
A restaurant that I think should be better known

A place that serves “real American food” where everything is American-American.

Taste, interior, atmosphere (song selection), everything
It brought back memories of when I went to America.

reviews.author: Da nahan (NieTMT)

This is a sandwich made with bacon fried several times and made into chicharon.

(When I eat burgers... I want it to be a little junky.)

reviews.author: Hyungbin Kim

It was good to enjoy a burger and chicken together, so it was a satisfying meal, and the Cheebu King Burger had a thick patty and fresh vegetables, so I was satisfied. The cheese balls were chewy and went well as a side, and the overall portions were generous, making it a great restaurant in Hongdae for a cost-effective meal.

We recommend delivery rather than visiting the store.

reviews.text:
It's a great Mexican restaurant.

As I said before, the food is really great. I've been here several times and have never been disappointed. I was satisfied every time.

The price is very reasonable too. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who likes tacos or similar foods.

reviews.author: kevin
reviews.text: If you are looking for special tteokbokki in Hongdae, I recommend Ex-Girlfriend Tteokbokki. The menu with a brunch feel rather than simple snack food is attractive👍 The signature menu item, Ex-Girlfriend Tteokbokki, is a combination of spicy taeyangcho sauce, potato mash, and cheese, giving it a unique taste, and is beautifully decorated with quail eggs and vegetables, making it a feast for both the eyes and the mouth 🙂 The side menu items, black octopus (fried squid ink) and corn ribs, are also popular. This place, known as the best tteokbokki restaurant in Hongik University Station, is open from 8 a.m. and offers a brunch menu, so you can visit at any time. It is a brunch space in Seogyo-dong with a nice atmosphere and is perfect for taking pictures, so I definitely recommend it to those looking for a good tteokbokki restaurant in Hongdae🥰

The main branch, which was located in Yeongdeungpo, has become larger and more diverse, and is now located in Hongdae. Bagels and ricotta cheese became more diverse, and there was space to enjoy them fully and satisfactorily.

What's special about this place is that the texture and taste are excellent, and at the same time, it is not a technique, but rather shows off the taste and characteristics of bagels made from rice.
When I first encountered Feel Free's bagels without any detailed explanation, I thought that they must have been made with flour and with more care. This is because it reminded me of the delicious bagels I used to eat, and I felt that it was even better than that. However, the bagels here are not only healthy rice bagels that are not commonly found, but they also taste unusually good. As I wrote less, the words became longer.

To sum up, if you like bagels, this is a cafe you can't help but become a regular. We recommend that you enjoy a well-balanced, delicious coffee with the natural taste of a bagel and the richness of an buttered bagel.

reviews.author: not maga
reviews.text:
When I first started taking baking classes, I was worried about whether I would be able to keep up, but now that I have successfully completed the entire course, I feel very proud.
The class was taught solidly from the basics, so even though I had no experience at all, I followed along step by step, and at some point, I gained confidence while seeing the bread and cakes I made with my own hands.

There was a high proportion of practical training, and the teacher personally demonstrated each step and gave feedback right away, which was very helpful. Although I have failed, I think I have learned more thanks to that experience.

I am so proud that my skills have improved so much that I can now gift desserts I made to people around me, and I think I did a great job learning.
I would like to tell those who were interested in baking but hesitated to give it a try :)

reviews.author: yuool
reviews.text:
I have never complained or written a bad review in my life, but I am so offended that I am leaving a review. I made a reservation for a barista consultation, and a male counselor was in charge.
When I initially inquired over the phone about the available curriculum and tuition fees, they said they would provide an in-person consultation, so I visited. The consultation only took about 20 minutes. I thought it would be too short a time to immediately decide to take the recommended 3-month course, so I said I would think about it first and get back to you.

Then he said, ‘I don’t like telling you this, but…’ and kept telling me to make a decision today and pay right here and now. I told him that I had to discuss it with my parents, so I told him to tell me over the phone right now, and ‘You know it’s already too late, right?’ and he responded in a burdensome way by repeatedly saying things like this.

Of course, I understand that you tried hard to recommend it considering my situation, but the attitude and nuance with which you spoke to me felt very rude to me, and paying for a course of about 1 million won may not be a lot of money to some people, but it felt like a burden to me as a student. Since I maintained an ambiguous attitude, he told me to take the lecture first, which would start in two days, and instead pay only 350,000 won now.
From a consumer's perspective, it is natural to want to spend rationally, and I have said several times euphemistically that I did not want to enroll right away but would think about it in the first place, but wouldn't encouraging registration in such a reckless way actually lower the reputation of the academy?
Since I had a feeling that I wouldn't be taking the class after that, I even wondered, "Why are they suddenly ignoring me like this?"

And the question he asked me at the end, ‘Are you thinking about going to Warhol?’ felt really sarcastic and made me feel very uncomfortable. What if I don’t want to go to Warhol? So what did I do wrong?

From a counseling perspective, recruiting students is an important task, so I understand that you are trying hard, but in the end, I am paying the full price to take the class, so isn't it my decision to choose? Why do I have to take the time to come for counseling and feel this humiliation? I've had quite a few experiences like this while doing PT counseling, but this is the first time I've experienced something as uneventful as this, so it's so absurd.
